title: Increasing Offering of Non-Chinese Official Languages at Preschools in Sengkang
what_it_is: Increasing Offering of Non-Chinese Official Languages at Preschools in Sengkang

sections.label: Preschool Mother Tongue Language Provision
sections.summary: ECDA works with Anchor Operators to expand Malay and Tamil preschool offerings, with plans to double provision to about 350 centres by 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The Early Childhood Development Agency (ECDA) has also been working closely with the Anchor Operators (AOPs) to expand the offering of MTL in preschools, especially in Malay and Tamil language.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: There are plans to double AOPs' provision of Malay and/or Tamil language education to about 350 centres by 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Nationally, about 1,800 or over 90% of preschools offer at least one MTL.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Of these, about 160 preschools offer all three MTLs and another 270 preschools offer two MTLs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Within the Sengkang planning area, about 30 preschools offer Malay language and about 10 preschools offer Tamil language.

sections.label: CPMTL Trained Preschool Educators
sections.summary: As of June 2021, over 300 in-service educators completed CPMTL for Malay and Tamil and were deployed as preschool MTL teachers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: As of June 2021, more than 300 in-service educators have completed the CPMTL for Malay and Tamil Language and have been deployed as MTL teachers in the preschools.

sections.label: Sengkang Licensed Preschool Language Offerings
sections.summary: Of 97 licensed preschool centres in Sengkang, 95 offer Chinese, 28 offer Malay and 10 offer Tamil language.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I am not sure what specific website or source the Member is referring to.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: But based on the information that I have, there are a total of 97 licensed preschool centres within the Sengkang planning area, of which 95 offer Chinese language, 28 offer Malay language and 10 offer Tamil language.

sections.label: Mother Tongue Teacher Capacity Plans
sections.summary: The reply cites 10,500 Chinese, 2,800 Malay and 700 Tamil, and plans to double AOP Malay and Tamil provision to about 350 centres by 2022.

sentences.speaker: Ms Raeesah Khan (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The answer was that there was 10,500 for Chinese Language, 2,800 for Malay Language and 700 for Tamil Language.

sentences.speaker: Ms Raeesah Khan (Aljunied)
sentences.text: I was just wondering what MOE will be doing to improve our capacities in offering Mother Tongue Languages in schools and increasing the number of teachers available.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I think I have answered the question in my main reply, which is there are plans to double the AOPs' provision of Malay and Tamil Language education to about 350 centres by 2022.
